uso: menu, Breath elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza
text: Welcome to Soul Charger. For the next three minutes, you'll slow down and breathe with a guide. While you do, we'll gently listen to your body: your breath, your heart, and your mind.

uso: menu, Draw elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza
text: Welcome to Soul Charger. For the next three minutes, you'll draw with light in the space around you. While you do, we'll gently listen to your heart and your mind.

uso: menu: el HUD termino de instalarse
text: Your signals are with you now. You're ready.

uso: Breath: aparece el metaball
text: This light moves with your breath. Breathe slowly, and watch it follow you.

uso: Breath: arranca el pacer
text: Now follow the guide. Let it set the rhythm.

uso: Breath: final, antes de los resultados
text: Beautifully done. Let's see what your body shared with us.

uso: Draw: se fue el trazo de practica
text: Good. The space is yours now. Draw until the time or the ink runs out.

uso: Draw: final, antes de los resultados
text: Well done. This is what you created, and what your body was saying while you drew.

uso: menu: el HUD termino de instalarse, explica lo que se mide (pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: During this experience, we'll be measuring your neural activity, your heart activity, and a calm index.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 1 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Pick up the sensor in front of you with your dominant hand.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 2 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Rest the sensor on your belly, just below your ribs. Breathe normally.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 3 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Breathe in and out slowly. The circle follows your belly.

uso: Breath, instrucciones pagina 4 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10) 20-10 tarde: sin START, solo la instruccion
text: You'll breathe in a steady cycle: inhale, hold, exhale. Follow the guide without forcing it.

uso: Draw, instrucciones pagina 1 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Pick up the brush with your dominant hand.

uso: Draw, instrucciones pagina 2 (lee el texto del panel; pedido de Beltran 20-10)
text: Your palette is in your other hand. Point at a color to choose it, and hold the trigger to draw. Try a first stroke. The experience begins after your first stroke.

uso: menu, Heart elegido: bienvenida mientras se avanza (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Welcome to Soul Charger. For the next three minutes, you'll listen to your heart. While you do, we'll gently listen to your body: your heart, and your mind.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 1 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Pick up the sensor in front of you with your dominant hand.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 2 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Place the sensor on your heart, on the left side of your chest. Then stay still for a moment.

uso: Heart, instrucciones pagina 3 (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia) (20-10 tarde: SIN USO, Heart quedo en dos paginas)
text: Each heartbeat becomes a pulse of light around you. Keep the sensor on your heart, and listen.

uso: Heart: primer pulso en el umbral (VO_17a del guion) (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Can you hear your heartbeat? Can you feel its rhythm?

uso: Heart: empieza la vuelta del mar (VO_17c del guion) (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Does gratitude flow through your heartbeat?

uso: Heart: final, antes de los resultados (pedido de Beltran 20-10: tercera experiencia)
text: Beautifully done. Let's see what your heart shared with us.

uso: menu: pista sin audio (subtitulo) para el boton START (20-10 tarde)
text: Point the button and press trigger

uso: menu: pista sin audio (subtitulo) para elegir experiencia (20-10 tarde)
text: Point the experience of your choice and press trigger
